create_scheduler: create a FlowMatchHeunDiscreteScheduler instance with custom num_train_timesteps and shift parameters
set_timesteps: set discrete timesteps for the diffusion chain before running inference with the scheduler
step_denoising: predict the previous sample by reversing the SDE using Heun's second-order method
scale_noise: apply the forward flow-matching process to scale noise into a sample at a given timestep
set_begin_index: set the begin index for the scheduler before running inference from a pipeline
